summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing of ZARAHATKE (PDP, Category listing+filters, Stripe/COD checkout, Shoppable Instagram). Backend: 50/50 pytest tests pass (all new + regression endpoints). Frontend: all requested flows verified except one CRITICAL defect — the cart drawer's 'PROCEED TO CHECKOUT' button uses window.location.href, which forces a full page reload; since the cart lives in React Context with no persistence, the cart is wiped and /checkout always renders 'Your bag is empty'.

ui_bugs.issue: PROCEED TO CHECKOUT uses window.location.href = '/checkout' -> full page reload wipes the React-Context cart. /checkout always shows the 'Your bag is empty' state. Reproduced twice (add via PDP ADD TO BAG, and via ProductCard ADD TO BAG). Fix: use react-router navigate('/checkout') and/or persist cart in localStorage.

Cart is useState-only with no localStorage persistence. After the Stripe redirect (window.location.href to checkout.stripe.com) and return to /payment/cancel, the cart is empty, yet the page claims 'No charge was made. Your bag is still saved — you can retry any time.' RETRY CHECKOUT then lands on the empty-bag state.

/category/dresses, /category/dupattas, /category/co-ord-sets have 0 seeded products and show 'No products match your filters. Try adjusting the price range.' which is misleading when the category itself is empty.
React hydration console error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' emitted on every Category page load (from the SORTS/price option labels). Noisy but non-blocking.

integration_issues.issue: Checkout is unreachable with items from the cart drawer (cart cleared by full reload). Only PDP 'BUY IT NOW' reaches a populated checkout.

action_items: CRITICAL: Replace window.location.href in CartSheet checkout-btn with react-router useNavigate('/checkout').
HIGH: Persist cart (and wishlist) to localStorage in StoreContext so the Stripe redirect round-trip and any reload keeps the bag, matching the /payment/cancel copy.
LOW: Show a dedicated 'No products in this collection yet' message for genuinely empty categories.
LOW: Fix the <span> inside <option> hydration warning in Category.jsx filter/sort selects.
Consider: StoreContext.addToCart dedupes by product.id only, so the same product added in two different sizes merges into one line and the second size is dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: CartSheet.jsx line ~115: window.location.href inside an SPA discards all in-memory state — always use navigate() for internal routes.
context/StoreContext.jsx: cart/wishlist held in useState with no persistence; any full reload (Stripe redirect, cancel return, refresh) loses the bag.

server.py compute_totals is authoritative server-side (good). Stripe amount passed as float rupees for INR — verify emergentintegrations converts to paise; totals matched (bs1 4199 -> order.total 4199), but the Stripe-side amount was not asserted.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (50 tests incl. backend_test.py, all green). Verified frontend flows: home sections, header nav for all 5 category links, homepage category tiles, Category filters (price 4->3 cards) and sort (order changes), PDP (size chips XS-XL, qty +/-, alert 'Please select a size', ADD TO BAG opens drawer, BUY IT NOW -> /checkout), COD end-to-end (order confirmation page with order-id, item, address, totals), Stripe POST returns https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (verified via route interception; Stripe hosted page NOT completed), /payment/cancel renders, Shoppable Instagram modal (3 products, caption, shoppable-add works, product link navigates + closes modal), wishlist & cart header counters. NOT tested: /payment/success polling (requires an actually paid session). After the CartSheet navigate fix, re-run: add to cart from a ProductCard -> open drawer -> PROCEED TO CHECKOUT -> expect checkout-page with items.
rca_of_the_issue: CartSheet.jsx uses `window.location.href = '/checkout'` for the PROCEED TO CHECKOUT button. That performs a browser-level navigation which unmounts and re-creates the React tree; StoreProvider re-initialises `cart` to [] because it is plain useState with no localStorage hydration. Result: /checkout renders the checkout-empty branch (`if (cart.length === 0)`), so the user can never check out from the cart drawer. Same root cause makes the /payment/cancel 'your bag is still saved' promise false after returning from Stripe. Fix = useNavigate() for the internal route + persist cart to localStorage.
